name: team_planning_plan
description: Get one Team Planning plan the caller is a member of: its name, base date, the caller's role in it (editor or viewer), the units it covers (scope: the whole organisation, or chosen units, each with everything under it), and whether it is frozen, which means no editor can still reach it, so its viewers read it and nobody changes it. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
